statement: Metformin reduces glioblastoma stem cell proliferation via AMPK-mediated mTOR inhibition.

B: Depletion of geranylgeranyl pyrophosphate impairing Rho GTPase signaling
statement: Atorvastatin decreases GBM invasion by blocking Rho GTPase prenylation through mevalonate pathway inhibition.

B: Copper-dependent ROS generation and proteasome inhibition
statement: Disulfiram combined with copper induces ferroptosis in GBM via ROS accumulation and proteasomal blockade.
Ivermectin suppresses GBM angiogenesis by targeting PAK1-mediated cytoskeletal remodeling in endothelial cells.

B: Blockade of Wnt/β-catenin and STAT3 pathways
statement: Niclosamide reverses temozolomide resistance in GBM by dual inhibition of Wnt/β-catenin and STAT3 signaling.
Artemisinin induces selective apoptosis in GBM cells through heme-dependent free radical production.

B: Activation of TRPV2 channels inducing autophagy
statement: Cannabidiol inhibits GBM viability by triggering TRPV2-mediated autophagic cell death.
Chloroquine enhances GBM radiosensitivity by inducing lysosomal membrane permeabilization and subsequent cathepsin release.

B: Microtubule depolymerization and Hedgehog pathway inhibition
statement: Mebendazole reduces GBM growth via dual microtubule disruption and Hedgehog signaling inhibition.
Valproic acid sensitizes GBM to TRAIL-induced apoptosis by epigenetically upregulating DR5 expression.

C: Improved blood-brain barrier penetration of chemotherapeutics
statement: Sildenafil improves BBB penetration of chemotherapeutics in GBM by modulating tight junctions via cGMP elevation.

B: Dopamine receptor D2 antagonism targeting glioma stem cells
statement: Thioridazine forces differentiation of GBM stem cells by blocking dopamine receptor D2 signaling.
Auranofin induces lethal oxidative stress in GBM by irreversibly inhibiting thioredoxin reductase.

B: STAT5 inhibition and lipid metabolism disruption
C: Sensitization of GBM to metabolic stress
statement: Pimozide sensitizes GBM to metabolic stress by inhibiting STAT5 and disrupting tumor lipid metabolism.
Penfluridol suppresses GBM migration by blocking T-type calcium channel-mediated calcium signaling.
